about: Every dial of every wear layer: name, range, default, unit, plain-words doc, kind and source. A dial name that is not in this table is an error, so a typo cannot hide. The common dials (amount, seed) belong to every layer. The look presets (data/looks) set the amount per layer and may set other dials. Carried from the weathering kit's table with the street-only dials dropped.

common.name: amount
common.doc: How strongly the layer acts, 0 = exactly nothing (the layer node returns its input unchanged).
common.source: the weathering kit re-check and the street (logs 22 and 25)

common.name: seed
common.doc: Picks one random pattern; a new number gives a new pattern with the same character.
